title: Resolution to reset property tax rates for fiscal year 2027
summary: This resolution amends and restates the Council's earlier tax-fixing resolution to set real property tax rates for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026, following a state law change allowing a lower cap on how much any one property class's tax share can grow. The levy totals $39,885,078,591, intended to raise a net $37,190,000,000 to help fund the $125,841,596,044 Fiscal 2027 budget. New tax rates are set for each property class, including 0.19972 for one-, two- and three-family homes and 0.12423 for other residential property.
